questions.question: You put an aluminium rod in a copper sulfate solution. Does a reaction occur? (use BINAS table 48)

answers.a: No, Cu<sup>2+</sup> is below Al in the table, so no reaction occurs
answers.b: No, metals never react with salt solutions
answers.c: No, because aluminium is an oxidising agent
answers.d: Yes, Cu<sup>2+</sup> is above Al in the table, so a reaction occurs

questions.question: BINAS table 48 gives: Fe<sup>2+</sup> + 2e<sup>−</sup> ⇌ Fe(s) at −0.45 V and 2H<sup>+</sup> + 2e<sup>−</sup> ⇌ H<sub>2</sub>(g) at 0.00 V. Does a reaction occur between Fe<sup>2+</sup> and H<sub>2</sub>(g)?

answers.a: No, the oxidising agent Fe<sup>2+</sup> is below the reducing agent H<sub>2</sub>
answers.b: Yes, because Fe<sup>2+</sup> has a negative potential
answers.c: Yes, because H<sub>2</sub> is above Fe<sup>2+</sup>
answers.d: No, because H<sub>2</sub> is not a reducing agent

questions.question: Which substance is the strongest oxidising agent in BINAS table 48?
Which substance is the strongest reducing agent in BINAS table 48?
Which formula belongs to the dichromate ion?
Which formula belongs to the permanganate ion?
How is the strength of a metal as a reducing agent related to how noble it is?

answers.a: The stronger the reducing agent, the more noble the metal
answers.c: Only noble metals are reducing agents
answers.d: The stronger the reducing agent, the less noble the metal

questions.question: What is corrosion?

answers.a: The melting of a metal at high temperature
answers.b: The dissolving of a salt in water
answers.c: The attack of a metal by a redox reaction with substances from its surroundings, such as oxygen and water
answers.d: Applying a layer of paint to a metal

questions.question: Why does iron rust away completely, while aluminium does not disappear completely through corrosion?

answers.a: Rust is porous and lets oxygen and water through; the oxide layer on aluminium seals the surface
answers.b: Aluminium is more noble than iron
answers.c: Iron is a stronger oxidising agent than aluminium
answers.d: Aluminium does not react with oxygen

questions.question: What is galvanising?

answers.a: Covering a metal with paint or plastic
answers.b: Covering a metal with a thin layer of another metal
answers.c: Melting two metals together to form an alloy
answers.d: Removing rust from a metal with acid

questions.question: Why are zinc blocks attached to the steel hull of a sea-going ship?

answers.a: Zinc is more noble than iron and forms a protective layer
answers.c: Zinc makes the sea water less salty
answers.d: Zinc is less noble than iron and therefore corrodes first

questions.question: Which electrode is the negative pole (−) in an electrochemical cell (battery) of zinc and copper?
What is the function of a salt bridge in an electrochemical cell?

answers.a: To let ions move, so that the charges in both half-cells stay balanced
answers.b: To let electrons flow from one solution to the other
answers.c: To make sure the two solutions never touch each other
